title: Physical ladder: first-order perturbation triplets (closed form)
question: What is missing in the phase model PhysKerr (9 %), and what does the classical perturbation method give at equal RM?
git_commit: recorded per run in results/runs/*.json (field git_commit); rule commit: see LOG.md
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation
model: y_k = x_k + sum_{(m,n)} C_{m,n} x_{k+m} x*_{k+m+n} x_{k+n}, |m|, |n|, |m+n| <= M, complex C (Tao et al., JLT 2011 form; not checked against the PDF here); x = received symbols after CDC; optional linear FIR on L symbols

arms.T1: XPM type (m = 0 or n = 0), C purely imaginary
arms.T3+FIR: all triplets + linear FIR on L in {7, 15}

fit: least squares on the residual s - x with ridge lambda chosen by validation BER (grid lambda_grid, relative to the mean diagonal of the normal matrix); normal equations accumulated in blocks of 4096 symbols
symmetry: C_{m,n} = C_{n,m} is imposed (x_{k+m} x_{k+n} is symmetric in m, n), so pairs are merged before fitting

rm.naive: 12 RM per triplet (two complex products 8 + coefficient 4) + FIR 4L
rm.sym: pairs (m, n), (n, m) share the coefficient: x_{k+m} x_{k+n} once (4), times x* (4), coefficient 4 per merged term -> 12 per merged term; reported as rm_sym; T1 (purely imaginary C): coefficient 2 instead of 4

bootstrap.rule: replica r resamples the 30 train files with replacement (numpy default_rng(r)); validation and test are fixed

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.xpm_insufficient: diagonal (XPM-type) physics is insufficient if T3 - T2 >= 5 p.p. at equal M (test mean over 5 replicas, M chosen by validation)
rule_draft.ours_vs_pbnlc: our approach is better than PB-NLC at equal RM if the Q2 gain difference >= 0.1 dB and the intervals do not overlap (E033 plot)
